placement.intro: Find out whether the learner has written an HTML page by hand before. Ask at most two short questions.

html.tagline: From the page skeleton to fixing a broken link.
html.placementHints: Start at page-structure for anyone new to HTML. Start at fix-the-link, skipping page-structure, only if the learner already writes HTML by hand and can say what goes in the head and what goes in the body.
